from: July book, night 4 (Fire on Mount Carmel)
p1: Many people prayed to a pretend god named Baal.
Elijah called everyone to Mount Carmel. He asked, “How long will you go back and forth? If the Lord is the true one, follow Him!”
Elijah said, “The one who answers with fire is the true one.” Baal’s helpers called out, but no one answered.
p2: Elijah built the Lord a stone table called an altar. He had water poured on it three times! He prayed, “Hear me, O Lord, so these people will know You.” Fire came down and burned it all up. It even dried up the water! The people bowed and said, “The Lord is the true one!”
The Lord was Jesus. Tonight, say, “I choose to follow Jesus.”
old: Many people had forgotten Heavenly Father. They worshiped a pretend god named Baal. Elijah said, “Let’s find out who the real God is!” He gathered everyone on top of a mountain.
The prophets of Baal called and called to their pretend god all day. But nothing happened — no answer at all. Baal was not real, so he could not hear them.
Then Elijah built an altar and prayed to the true God. He even poured water all over it! Suddenly, FIRE came down from heaven and burned it all up — the water, the wood, even the stones!
Everyone fell down and said, “The Lord, He is the real God!” There is only one true God — our Heavenly Father. He is real, He is powerful, and He hears us. We follow Him because He is true.
